name: ex_nesting.k
smt:
; ================
; === Options: ===
; ================

(set-option :smt.macro-finder true)

; ======================
; === String Theory: ===
; ======================

; Z3 4.13.0+ requires explicit logic or theory declaration for strings
(set-logic ALL)

; ===========================
; === Built-in datatypes: ===
; ===========================

(define-sort Ref () Int)

(declare-datatypes (T1 T2) ((Tuple2 (mk-Tuple2 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)))))
(declare-datatypes (T1 T2 T3) ((Tuple3 (mk-Tuple3 (_1 T1)(_2 T2)(_3 T3)))))


; ===============================
; === User-defined datatypes: ===
; ===============================

(declare-datatypes () ((Outer (mk-Outer (x Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Inner (mk-Inner (y Int)))))
(declare-datatypes () ((Very_Inner (mk-Very_Inner (z Int)))))

; =============
; === Heap: ===
; =============

(declare-datatypes () ((Any
  (lift-Outer (sel-Outer Outer))
  (lift-Inner (sel-Inner Inner))
  (lift-Very_Inner (sel-Very_Inner Very_Inner))
  null))
)

(declare-const heap (Array Ref Any))
(declare-const NULL$ String)
(declare-const NULL$Ref Ref)
(assert (= NULL$Ref (- 1)))

(define-fun deref ((ref Ref)) Any
  (select heap ref)
)

; ==========================================
; === Class specific is/deref-functions: ===
; ==========================================

(define-fun deref-is-Outer ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Outer (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Outer ((this Ref)) Outer
  (sel-Outer (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Inner ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Inner (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Inner ((this Ref)) Inner
  (sel-Inner (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-is-Very_Inner ((this Ref)) Bool
  (is-lift-Very_Inner (deref this))
)

(define-fun deref-Very_Inner ((this Ref)) Very_Inner
  (sel-Very_Inner (deref this))
)

; ======================
; === Isa-functions: ===
; ======================

(define-fun deref-isa-Outer ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Outer this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Inner ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Inner this)
)

(define-fun deref-isa-Very_Inner ((this Ref)) Bool
  (deref-is-Very_Inner this)
)

; ================
; === Getters: ===
; ================

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Outer:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Outer.x: ---

(define-fun Outer!x ((this Ref)) Int
  (x (deref-Outer this))
)

; ----------------------------
;   Getters for class Inner:
; ----------------------------

; --- getters for Inner.y: ---

(define-fun Inner!y ((this Ref)) Int
  (y (deref-Inner this))
)

; ---------------------------------
;   Getters for class Very_Inner:
; ---------------------------------

; --- getters for Very_Inner.z: ---

(define-fun Very_Inner!z ((this Ref)) Int
  (z (deref-Very_Inner this))
)

; ================
; === Methods: ===
; ================

; ===================
; === Invariants: ===
; ===================

; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Outer:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-1-Outer Outer)



; ------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Inner:
; ------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-2-Inner Inner)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Inner.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Outer!x 1) (Inner!y this))
)

(assert (! (Inner.inv1 2) :named _xkassert0))



; -----------------------------------
;   Invariant for class Very_Inner:
; -----------------------------------

; --- Constants: ---

(declare-const const-3-Very_Inner Very_Inner)

; --- Invariant 1: ---

(define-fun Very_Inner.inv1 ((this Ref)) Bool
  (= (Very_Inner!z this) (Outer!x 1))
)

(assert (! (Very_Inner.inv1 3) :named _xkassert1))




; ======================
; === Generate heap: ===
; ======================

(assert
  (=
    heap
    (store(store(store
      ((as const (Array Ref Any)) null)
        1 (lift-Outer const-1-Outer))
        2 (lift-Inner const-2-Inner))
        3 (lift-Very_Inner const-3-Very_Inner))
  )
)
smtModel:
(define-fun const-2-Inner () Inner
  (mk-Inner 2))
(define-fun const-1-Outer () Outer
  (mk-Outer 2))
(define-fun const-3-Very_Inner () Very_Inner
  (mk-Very_Inner 2))
(define-fun _xkassert0 () Bool
  (= (x (sel-Outer (select heap 1))) (y (sel-Inner (select heap 2)))))
(define-fun _xkassert1 () Bool
  (= (z (sel-Very_Inner (select heap 3))) (x (sel-Outer (select heap 1)))))
(define-fun NULL$Ref () Int
  (- 1))
(define-fun heap () (Array Int Any)
  (let ((a!1 (store (store ((as const (Array Int Any)) null)
                         1
                         (lift-Outer (mk-Outer 2)))
                  2
                  (lift-Inner (mk-Inner 2)))))
  (store a!1 3 (lift-Very_Inner (mk-Very_Inner 2)))))
